19. **The living map.** (added 29 October 2026) Haakon: "In time I want environmental effects, seasons reflected on the map. Characters, armies, fighting shown, etc. Everything you can think of, which makes it a better game for a player or viewer. But I don't believe the time for these effects are quiet yet." With every feature built, the map's look becomes a blend of Imperator: Rome's map and a museum map of the Bronze Age world ("The map in true geography, and its look in time" under Interface): the environment and the seasons on the map, characters, armies and battles as they travel and fight, and whatever else makes the game better to play or to watch, each measured on a throttled phone. Presentation only, with no change to rules, numbers or balance, so it may run beside item 18. **Stop for review.**
